report.summary:
Both microduck.observe and microduck.verify returned runtime_refused, indicating the synthetic read-only environment is not providing any real ROS/robot data. No GO tag was observed, no command was issued, and no physical motion occurred. The task explicitly required no motion and only diagnostic observation; since both observation and verification were refused, there is no evidence of any real command or successful walk. This is a model-only test with synthetic data, not physical proof of perception or motion.
